message.title: Prosafe SE: Invitation to Q3 2026 results and webcast on 20 November
message.body:
06 November 2026 -- Prosafe SE will release its third quarter 2026 results on
20 November 2026 at 7:00 a.m. CET. The quarterly earnings release and
presentation will be available on www.newsweb.no and www.prosafe.com.

Reese McNeel, CEO, and Halvdan Kielland, CFO, will host a webcast and Q&A at
10:00 a.m. CET on 20 November 2026. The webcast can be followed via
www.prosafe.com.

Questions can be submitted using the Q&A function embedded in the webcast. A
replay will be available on Prosafe's website shortly after the presentation.

Contacts
For further information, please contact:
Reese McNeel, CEO
Phone: +47 415 08 186

About Us
Prosafe is a leading owner and operator of semi-submersible accommodation and
construction support units.
The company is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange with ticker code PRS. For
more information, please refer to https://www.prosafe.com
(https://www.prosafe.com/)

This information has been submitted pursuant to the Securities Trading Act §
5-12 and MAR. The information was submitted for publication, through the
agency of the contact persons set out above, at 2026-11-06 11:22 CET.
